goal: Decide whether one text message is likely a scam, likely safe, or uncertain, and explain why in plain words an older adult can understand.

message.text: Publishers Prize Office: to release your winnings, send the $250 processing charge by MoneyGram or Venmo.

explanation: This looks like a scam. It asks you to send money through a money app, which is very hard to get back. It also says you won a prize, which is a common trick. Do not pay any fee to claim a prize.
what_to_do: Do not reply, do not tap any link, and do not send money or codes. You can delete it. If you are worried, talk to Priya (daughter).
guide_tip: Tip from our guide (G07): Delete the message. Do not pay any fee to claim a prize.
